summary: OFAC's 05 Nov 2026 SDN List update makes three sets of changes. First, it adds seven individuals and over two dozen Cambodian, Hong Kong, Singaporean, Malaysian, Mauritian and British Virgin Islands entities under the [TCO] tag, most 'Linked To' PRINCE GROUP TRANSNATIONAL CRIMINAL ORGANIZATION or to a small group of controlling individuals (QIU, Yong; CHEN, Bo; PANG, Visal; DAI, An) -- framed in the press release as targeting 'Global Scam Networks and the Corporate Infrastructure That Enables Them.' Several of these entities share identical registered addresses or offshore (BVI) incorporation. Second, OFAC adds Cuban individuals, Cuban state-owned enterprises and a Chinese state-owned electronics company (CEIEC) under the Cuba-related EO 14404 program, alongside publication of a sectoral determination covering electronics, manufacturing, marine and technology, and describes 'Further Sanctions on the Cuban Regime's Foreign Military Support and Illicit Revenue Networks.' Third, OFAC adds two new Cuba-flagged tankers and amends three existing Venezuela-sanctioned vessel entries to show renaming and reflagging to Cuba (same IMO numbers retained), all linked to CAROIL TRANSPORT MARINE LTD or PETROLEOS MARITIMOS DEL CARIBE S.A., while the pre-existing Venezuela sanctions tag is kept.

extraction_notes: This is an OFAC SDN List update, not a narrative advisory; it lists ~45 designation/amendment entries (individuals, entities and vessels) across pages 1-7. This record captures a representative subset of named actors sufficient to evidence the two identified typologies (Shell Company Network for the Prince Group TCO corporate infrastructure; Shadow Fleet for the Cuba/Venezuela tanker renaming-and-reflagging pattern); it does not individually enumerate every one of the ~30 Cambodian/Hong Kong/BVI/Singapore/Malaysia/Mauritius entities added under the [TCO] tag, nor every Cuba-related individual/entity added under [CUBA-EO14404]. All actor names queried against the governed actor register returned 'Unresolved' (no existing identity match); none should be treated as resolved to an actor_id. CHEN, Bo; DAI, An; LI, Thet and LASTRES MORERA, Ania Guillermina appear in this document only as the party another entry is 'Linked To' -- they have no independent SDN entry text in this extract, so their own attributes (DOB, nationality, etc.) are not stated here. The Cuba-related sectoral Determination under EO 14404 (electronics, manufacturing, marine, technology sectors) and the BEIJING H AND C TECHNOLOGIES / EMPRESA COMERCIALIZADORA / CUBAELECTRONICA / INTERNACIONAL MARITIMA SA entries are noted in the source but were not linked to a typology because the document does not develop a laundering technique for them beyond bare designation; a human reviewer may wish to assess whether these belong under a sanctions/state-owned-enterprise typology not captured by this extraction.
